stemMarkdown: A rectangular garden 40 m by 15 m is surrounded by a path 3 m wide running all around it on the outside. Find the area (in square m) of the path.
solutionMarkdown: The outer rectangle measures $46$ m by $21$ m, an area of $966$ square m. Subtracting the garden's $600$ square m leaves $366$.
altSolutionMarkdown: The path widens the plot on both sides, so each dimension grows by twice the width.
